newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allots 61.0 bln marks repos, adds funds.
newsitem.headline: Buba allots 61.0 bln marks repos, adds funds.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Tuesday it had allocated 61.0 billion marks in securities repurchase funds at a fixed three percent rate.

The central bank accepted 22.9 percent of the bids for the 15-day funds. A repo pact for 59.9 billion marks, also set at a fixed three percent rate, expires today, Wednesday, so a net 1.1 billion marks is flowing into the market.
The Bundesbank has kept its main money market rate, the repo, fixed at three percent since last August.
Banks bid for a total of 266.4 billion marks of the funds.
The repo tender was set for one day longer than usual, and allocated one day earlier usual, due to Thursday's May Day holiday. --Frankfurt Newsroom, +49 69 756525
